product_lines: My cofounder and I started by open-sourcing alternatives to paid software. Our videos reached 25M+ views, but people still struggled to install, maintain and customize the software.
Publik makes those apps accessible through Iris, which handles setup, fixes bugs and adds features around each user's needs. We are building a marketplace where software adapts to people.
traction_lines: We have crossed 7,500 registered users in under two months and have 2,100 Discord members.
